decks.name: LeetCode #208 - Implement Trie (Prefix Tree)
decks.description: Implement a trie (prefix tree) data structure with insert, search, and startsWith operations

cards.question: Implement Trie (Prefix Tree): Implement the Trie class with the following methods: 1) Trie() initializes the trie object, 2) void insert(String word) inserts the string word into the trie, 3) boolean search(String word) returns true if the string word is in the trie, and 4) boolean startsWith(String prefix) returns true if there is a previously inserted string that has the prefix.

solutions.name: Prefix Tree (Hash Map)
solutions.explanation: Use a hash map to store children nodes, providing flexible storage that only allocates memory for characters that exist. Each node tracks whether it marks the end of a word.

solutions.name: Prefix Tree (Array)
solutions.explanation: Use a fixed-size array of 26 elements to store children nodes for lowercase letters. Provides O(1) access time but uses more memory as it allocates space for all 26 letters at each node.
